ItemID: unavailable; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I want more of Tool's intricate rhythms and immersive songs.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Bends; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm looking for heavier riffs right now rather than Radiohead's more restrained alternative rock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Toxicity; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd choose its aggressive riffs and melodic hooks alongside my recent heavy rock listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent Tool listening makes this another strong choice for intense, layered songs.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: God Hates Us All       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its aggression fits some of my metal listening, but I'd choose more melodic material this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Brave New World; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal sound appeals, but I'm more interested in following my recent Tool and Disturbed listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Asylum; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More Disturbed sounds appealing after Ten Thousand Fists, but I wouldn't pick both recommended albums today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Indestructible; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I'd try this for the forceful riffs and strong vocal hooks I enjoy in Disturbed.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Reign In Blood       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The intensity fits my heavier listening, but relentless thrash isn't my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy guitars and catchy choruses fit, though I'm prioritizing Tool and Disturbed this visit.
